bugs_found: compound_interest does not reject negative principal, allowing nonsensical negative balances/returns
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months via int(), changing terms without caller awareness
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so float/int/string/NaN inputs can fail inconsistently or bypass expected precision rules
transfer updates source balance before destination balance with no atomic rollback; a failing destination assignment can debit without credit
transfer treats currency codes case-insensitively, silently allowing malformed/non-canonical currencies like usd vs USD
fx_convert does not validate FX rates are positive, finite Decimals, so zero/negative/NaN rates can produce invalid converted amounts
